sections.heading: Which admission route applies?
paragraphs: Chandigarh University’s general admissions page now refers to the 2027–28 intake and CUCET 2027. Its current general programme catalogue did not establish a domestic B.Sc.Agriculture offering in this research pass. Applicants must first obtain written confirmation of the programme, campus and intake before treating the historic accredited entry as an available seat.

faqs.answer: The 31 st NAEAB proceedings approve B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 19 July 2022 to 18 July 2027.

faqs.question: Was the agriculture institute itself approved in that decision?
faqs.answer: No. The same proceedings explicitly say the University Institute of Agriculture Sciences was not approved for accreditation. The degree decision must not be expanded into blanket institute accreditation.

faqs.question: Is a current agriculture intake confirmed?
faqs.answer: No. The official admissions and institute pages read did not establish a current domestic agriculture application route. Ask CU admissions directly.

faqs.question: Can fees from the integrated international page be used?
faqs.answer: No. That page concerns an integrated agriculture–MBA award and retains Admissions 2016 navigation. It is not a current domestic agriculture fee schedule.

faqs.question: Are CU’s wider placement figures agriculture outcomes?
faqs.answer: The pages read do not provide an agriculture breakdown, so university-wide placement claims are not used as agriculture outcomes.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for CU?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University is recorded as established in 2012.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for CU?
faqs.answer: https://www.cuchd.in/admissions/ is a general admissions channel; the researched current catalogue does not confirm an available domestic agriculture intake.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact CU?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: 1800 1212 88800; Public email: admissions@cumail.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at CU?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/chandigarh-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at CU?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/chandigarh-university/admission-process).

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at CU?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to CU work?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University’s general admissions page now refers to the 2027–28 intake and CUCET 2027. Its current general programme catalogue did not establish a domestic B.Sc.Agriculture offering in this research pass. Applicants must first obtain written confirmation of the programme, campus and intake before treating the historic accredited entry as an available seat. Confirm the current prospectus: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application. Request a written cost statement: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for CU?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University: • B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2022-07-19 to 2027-07-18. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at CU?
faqs.answer: CU’s current institute list describes the wider academic campus. A programme-specific agriculture farm, laboratory inventory and field-training schedule were not verified. General university facilities are not substituted for evidence of agricultural teaching access.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at CU?
faqs.answer: CU’s current institute list describes the wider academic campus. A programme-specific agriculture farm, laboratory inventory and field-training schedule were not verified. General university facilities are not substituted for evidence of agricultural teaching access.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for CU?
faqs.answer: CU’s current institute list describes the wider academic campus. A programme-specific agriculture farm, laboratory inventory and field-training schedule were not verified. General university facilities are not substituted for evidence of agricultural teaching access. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for CU?
faqs.answer: No current agriculture-specific scholarship terms were verified. The legacy international integrated-course page lists historical international concessions, which should not be applied to a domestic B.Sc. Agriculture enquiry.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for CU?
faqs.answer: CU pages display university-wide placement marketing, but the evidence read does not identify agriculture cohorts, recruiters or outcomes. Those wider figures are excluded from the agriculture profile.

faqs.question: How can I contact CU about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 1800 1212 88800. Published email: admissions@cumail.in. Official admissions: https://www.cuchd.in/admissions/

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for CU?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://www.cuchd.in/admissions/; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
